findings.description: The real left wall has one single-leaf door with one EXIT sign above it and only plain wall with a thermostat to its left. The mirror shows a double door: two glazed leaves in a shared frame, clearest at 00:05.5 and 00:09.75, with two EXIT signs. The reflected thermostat sits to the right of the second leaf. That puts an extra door and extra exit sign at a spot the real image shows as blank wall between the door and the thermostat. The reflection is inconsistent with the real layout throughout the clip (00:00-00:09.75). No off-screen connection or lens effect explains it.
